<div class="home-extras"><section id="project-team" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="project-team">Team</h2>
<div class="team-grid">
<ul>
<li><strong>Philip S. Rosenberg</strong></li>

<p>Philip S. Rosenberg, PhD, developed the MATISSE toolbox and its code. The toolbox implements methods developed with the cancer surveillance research community. These include the APC methods described with Adalberto Miranda Filho in Front Oncol 2024. The team listed above develops the course.</p>
</section><section id="faq" class="home-faq"><h2>FAQ</h2><details><summary>Do I need to buy MATLAB to use MATISSE?</summary><p>You can use MATLAB Online in your browser. Sign in with a MathWorks account and check the current access terms. Follow <a href="getting-started.html#getting-started-with-matlab-online" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Getting started with MATLAB Online</a> to set up the toolbox. You need a MATLAB license to use a local copy.</p></details><details><summary>Do I need to know MATLAB already?</summary><p>Some familiarity helps. Start with the Overview live script to learn how the toolbox works. Run one section at a time and inspect the result. Use <a href="toolbox-guide.html#getting-help" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Getting help</a> when a command is unfamiliar.</p></details><details><summary>Is MATISSE peer reviewed / published?</summary><p>The methods are described in Miranda Filho &amp; Rosenberg, <em>Advances in statistical methods for cancer surveillance research: an age-period-cohort perspective</em> (Front Oncol, 2024). Download the paper from <a href="resources.html#downloads">Downloads</a>. For individual methods, such as SAGE and comparative APC analysis, open <a href="resources.html#related-methods-and-publications">Related methods and publications</a>.</p></details><details><summary>How do I ask a question or get help?</summary><p>A shared inbox for course and methods questions is being set up. Contact details will appear here when it is ready. For now, use the toolbox's built-in help. See <a href="toolbox-guide.html#getting-help" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Getting help</a> for the commands.</p></details><details><summary>Will the live sessions be recorded?</summary><p>Yes. Recordings will be linked here when they are available.</p></details></section></div>
